description: Installation of a replacement front shop front with windows, glazed double doors and fascia and projecting signs and replacement rear windows and doors to the ground floor retail unit (Class E).
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications:  19247-MP-101 (Rev E), 19247-MP-102 (Rev A)
Received:  06 February 2024,  03302_001, 03302_002, 03302_003, 03302_004
Received:  29 September 2023,  19247-MP-100, 19247-MP-103, 19247-MP-104
Received:  12 May 2023.  

Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The ground floor commercial unit's replacement front shopfronts shall have black blue (RAL 5004) aluminium framed windows, black blue (RAL 5004) stall risers, timber fascia panels and a black blue (RAL 5004) aluminium and acrylic projecting sign only and be permanently retained as such.  

The ground floor commercial unit's replacement rear windows shall be black aluminium framed windows only and be permanently retained as such.  

Reasons:  To protect the character and appearance of the building and Chiswick town centre in accordance with Local Plan Policies CC1 (Context and Character) and CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture).
